name: exoticnailsbyyuli
description: APK Android para Exotic Nails by Yuly

scripts.android:add: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync android && npm run android:icons
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run android:sync && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-apk-debug.ps1
